main.summary: Controls runtime data isolation behavior for data items and related metadata APIs.

field.name: scopedmode
field.summary: Ambient scoped override for the current data isolation mode.

property.name: Mode
property.summary: The default runtime mode that controls whether data isolation work is enabled or disabled.

method.name: BeginScope
method.summary: Begin a scoped override for the current data isolation mode.
method.returns: A disposable scope that restores the previous data isolation mode when disposed.

method.name: Disable
method.summary: Disable data isolation behavior for the default runtime mode.

method.name: Enable
method.summary: Enable data isolation behavior for the default runtime mode.

method.name: IsDisabled
method.summary: Determine whether data isolation behavior is currently disabled for the active scope.
method.returns: when data isolation behavior is currently disabled for the active scope; otherwise, .

method.name: IsEnabled
method.summary: Determine whether data isolation behavior is currently enabled for the active scope.
method.returns: when data isolation behavior is currently enabled for the active scope; otherwise, .

method.name: IsScopeActive
method.summary: Determine whether a scoped data isolation override is currently active for the logical execution flow.
method.returns: when a scoped override is active; otherwise, .

method.name: GetScopedMode
method.summary: Get the scoped data isolation override currently applied to the active logical execution flow, if any.
method.returns: The scoped data isolation override currently applied to the active logical execution flow, if any.

method.name: SetScopedMode
method.summary: Set or clear the scoped data isolation override for the active logical execution flow.
